items.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
items.summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

items.title: GTA VI was built by hand. The man who ran Take-Two during GTA IV says AI could let a filmmaker make the next breakout game
items.summary: Take-Two says generative AI played no part in GTA VI. Ben Feder says AI will soon let new creators build games with a point and a click.
items.titleZh: GTA VI是手工制造的。在GTA IV期间运行Take-Two的人说，人工智能可以让电影制作人制作下一个突破性的游戏
items.summaryZh: Take-Two表示，生成式人工智能在《GTA VI》中没有发挥作用。Ben Feder表示，人工智能很快就会让新的创作者通过点击来构建游戏。

items.title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
